requirement.evidence: It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services in the jurisdiction of this state.
requirement.note: The statute's prohibition on use/distribution as part of a conspiracy and on coercion is supported, and the definition of common pricing algorithm matches. But the document applies to any "person", not specifically landlords or software vendors, and says nothing about rent. The advice to report to the Attorney General or consult a lawyer is not in the document.
